channel.title: Fore Ladies Golf Blog
channel.description: Women's golf style, fit and dress-code guides from Fore Ladies Golf.

item.title: Golf Jackets for Women: Softshell vs Windbreaker vs Insulated
item.description: Softshell, windbreaker, insulated or rain jacket? How women's golf jackets differ in warmth, stretch and weather protection, and how to pick one for your round.

item.title: What to Wear Golfing: A Complete Outfit Guide for Women
item.description: What women wear to play golf, piece by piece: collared tops, skorts, pants, dresses, shoes and layers, plus how to read a course dress code before you go.

item.title: Women's Golf Dress Code: What's Allowed and What Isn't
item.description: Women's golf dress codes explained: collars, sleeveless tops, skort length, leggings, denim and shoes — and how private, public and resort courses differ.

item.title: How Long Should a Golf Skort Be? A Length Guide by Height
item.description: How golf skort lengths are measured, what 15, 16, 17, 18 and 20 inch skorts look like on different heights, and which length suits strict dress codes.

item.title: Golf Skort vs Golf Skirt vs Golf Shorts: Which Should You Wear?
item.description: Golf skort, golf skirt or golf shorts? How they differ in coverage, pockets, comfort and dress codes, and which suits your swing, the weather and your course.

item.title: What to Wear Golfing in Cold Weather: A Layering Guide for Women
item.description: How to dress for golf in cold weather: base layers, quarter-zips, vests, wind jackets, winter golf pants, gloves and hats, with outfits by temperature.

item.title: Hot Weather Golf Outfits: Staying Cool and Sun-Safe on the Course
item.description: How to dress for golf in the heat: breathable fabrics, UPF sun protection explained, sleeves vs sleeveless, hats, colors and what to pack for a summer round.

item.title: How to Choose Women's Golf Shoes: Spiked, Spikeless and Waterproof
item.description: Spiked or spikeless? Waterproof or breathable? How to choose women's golf shoes for grip, comfort and fit over 18 holes, plus when sneakers are fine.

item.title: How to Wash Golf Clothes So They Last: A Care Guide for Performance Fabrics
item.description: How to wash and dry golf polos, skorts and outerwear: cold water, no fabric softener, low heat, plus how to remove grass, sunscreen and sweat stains.

item.title: How to Choose a Golf Dress That Fits and Works on the Course
item.description: What makes a good golf dress: collar or mock neck, built-in shorts, pockets for balls, the right torso length and stretch, plus how to size it and style it.

item.title: Can You Wear Tennis Clothes Golfing? Tennis vs Golf Apparel Explained
item.description: Can a tennis skirt, tank or dress pass a golf dress code? How tennis and golf apparel differ in length, collars and pockets, and which pieces cross over.

item.title: Golf Trip Packing List for Women: Outfits, Gear and Extras
item.description: A practical golf trip packing list for women: how many outfits to bring, mix-and-match pieces, shoes, layers, rain gear, travel bag tips and clubhouse clothes.

item.title: What to Wear to the Driving Range or Your First Golf Lesson
item.description: What women should wear to a first golf lesson, the driving range or a simulator: comfortable clothes that let you swing, the right shoes, and what to bring.

item.title: Women's Golf Rain Gear: How to Stay Dry and Keep Playing
item.description: What to wear golfing in the rain: waterproof vs water-resistant jackets, rain pants, rain gloves, waterproof shoes, umbrellas and towels, and how to keep grips dry.

item.title: Vitamin Tee
item.description: HOW HAS GOLF CHANGED YOUR LIFE? SHARE YOUR STORY! VITAMIN TEE: TRUE STORIES OF HOPE IN THE HAZARDS OF LIFE Golf was my light in the darkness...

item.description: Spring is around the corner, and with it comes plans for vacation.

item.description: The LPGA Tour headed to the Blythefield Country Club in Belmont, Michigan for the Meijer LPGA Classic for Simply Give.
